model_annotation: The overall purpose of this plot is to compare the runtime performance of various LLM compression methods. The x-axis represents the number of training-free experiments, ranging from 25 to 250, with a linear scale. The y-axis indicates the runtime in milliseconds (ms), with a linear scale and values ranging from 10.00 to 80.00. The x-axis ticks are spaced at intervals of 25, and the y-axis ticks are spaced at intervals of 10.  The first line, labeled “Vanilla,” is a solid blue line starting at a runtime of 70.89 ms and decreasing to 69.67 ms at the end of the x-axis.  The line “StrmLLM(n=256)” is a solid green line, beginning at 71.42 ms and declining to 47.54 ms. The “StrmLLM(n=256)” line presents a steady decline across the x-axis. The “SepLLM(n=256)” line is a solid red line beginning at 77.18 ms and decreasing to 47.36 ms. Similarly, the “SepLLM” line shows a steady decline across the x-axis. The “SepLLM(n=256)_+28” line, displayed in orange, starts at 77.18 ms and decreases to 47.36 ms. The  “SepLLM(n=256)_+28” line demonstrates a steady decline across the x-axis.  The “ARCc” line, represented in purple, starts at 20.14 ms and reaches a peak of 46.80 ms at the midpoint, then decreases to 34.83 ms at the end of the x-axis. The “LBD-acc” line is a dashed magenta line that starts at 23.81 ms and rises to 62.84 ms.  The “LBD-acc” line shows an increase then a decrease across the x-axis. The “Logica” line, depicted in brown, starts at 23.81 ms and rises to 63.82 ms. The “Logica” line exhibits an increase followed by a steady decline across the x-axis. The "PioQA" line, in teal, begins at 25.40 ms and ends at 80.10 ms. The “Atten.” line is shown in pink, beginning at 100.00 ms and decreasing to 32.77 ms.
